text:
𝗡𝗭 𝗙𝗜𝗚𝗛𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞! 🇳🇿

Nicholls and Phillips rebuilt NZ from 70/5 to 165/5 after 54.3 overs in Wellington.
Phillips reached a fifty; Bumrah has 3 wickets.

Can India break through? 👇
#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗭 𝗡𝗘 𝗞𝗜𝗬𝗔 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗘𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞! 🇳🇿🏏

👉 Wellington Test mein NZ 70/5 se 165/5 tak pahunche (54.3 overs)
👉 Nicholls aur Phillips ne innings sambhali, Phillips ka fifty
👉 Bumrah ke 3 wicket: Latham, Mitchell, Blundell

Kya India NZ ko jaldi samet payega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
